Deep audit of the gold-100 benchmark and eval, 2026-07-20, all of it also in v3/output/DATA_README.md. Cross-arm VALID: context_recall_id (exact, gold-set denominator) and the judged trio under one judge - faithfulness, answer_correctness, context_recall_llm. NOT cross-arm comparable: context_precision_id, whose denominator is every id carried by retrieved chunks, so with artefact chunks packing ~500 ids per question against the baselines' ~50 it measures id-density rather than quality; context_precision_nonllm and context_recall_nonllm, string-similarity of context text that punishes the artefact's raw-JSON context format regardless of content (recall_id >= 0.8 on 33 questions whose recall_nonllm averages 0.046); and exact_match (0.000 all arms), string_presence, bleu, rouge and semantic_similarity, which are entity-list golds against prose answers

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Benchmark construction facts. gold100.jsonl is 22 person / 55 content / 17 pr / 5 company / 1 url - not the equal 20-per-type draw build_question_sets.py produces, and its real draw predates the current question file; company n=5 and url n=1 are anecdotes. Company questions are two-hop joins: products/ names customers only as CUST- ids and metadata/customers_data.json maps CUST to company, but lucene and vector ingest products/ ONLY, baked in since the arms' first commit a45292f and not a deliberate decision, so they structurally cannot answer them, while the artefact ingests metadata and retrieved no mapping chunk for any of the 5. Gold citations average 39 per question with a maximum of 254, so questions with more than 50 citations cannot reach recall 1.0 at k=50 - the same ceiling for every arm. The artefact system bottleneck is extraction, not retrieval: its contexts hold 87% of gold employee-ids and its answers surface 26%. Baselines abstain a lot - lucene 38/100, vector 35/100, artefact 6/100 - and within-arm, abstentions and non-abstentions score about equal faithfulness
